scope.implementation: typed encode-only TokenCommandBuffer wrappers for dormant GLM resident primitives

guards: all buffer byte ranges are checked before encode
all size and grid arithmetic is checked
GLM RoPE requires even rotary_dim and strides at least rotary_dim
undersized buffers fail before dispatch_count changes
residual-add zero length is a no-dispatch success
residual-add n must fit the Metal u32 ABI and its rounded grid must not overflow

residual_add_contract.alias_safety_basis: one thread owns each element and the shader performs no cross-element access

exact_decisions: causal DSA mask writes negative infinity beyond position
continuous_passes: expanded-cache sparse attention with ascending allow-list
exact_elementwise_passes: residual add over exactly representable fixtures, including full-buffer x/y aliasing

constraints_and_negative_evidence.compact_requirement: eventual attention must consume normalized 512-wide MLA latent plus shared 64-wide RoPE tail, or reconstruct expanded K/V only for selected positions
constraints_and_negative_evidence.topk_to_sparse_order_hazard: stable-top-k emits score order; current host sparse attention accumulates in ascending position order. The sparse wrapper therefore requires unique ascending allow_idx and cannot directly consume the top-k output without an exact reorder primitive.
constraints_and_negative_evidence.serial_kernel_risk: stable top-k is one-thread O(n*k), while sparse softmax and value accumulation are serialized on thread 0 per head. Correctness parity does not establish runtime feasibility.
constraints_and_negative_evidence.static_trace_registry_on_base: the historical branch base did not list these dormant names; metal/mod.rs was deliberately not edited in the conflict-minimal branch patch
constraints_and_negative_evidence.static_trace_registry_on_integrated_main: integration commit cd7c5410 applies after a0dd47b9, whose static_kernel_name table already lists the 12 original dormant kernel names; gravity_add_inplace_f32 is also explicitly registered, so all 13 typed route-segment wrappers have exact static trace names and none can be attributed as other
constraints_and_negative_evidence.residual_add_static_trace_on_integrated_: gravity_add_inplace_f32 is explicitly registered and the wrapper test asserts the exact source and static trace name
